verses.text: So we must pay even more attention to what we have heard, so that we do not drift away from it.
The message God gave through angels was firm, and everyone who broke it or disobeyed it was fairly punished.
So how can we escape if we ignore such a great salvation? The Lord himself first told us about it, and those who heard him proved to us that it is true.
God also showed it was true by signs, wonders and many kinds of miracles, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit that he gave as he wanted.
God did not put angels in charge of the world to come, the world we are talking about.
Somewhere in the Scriptures someone says, "What are people, that you think about them? What is a son of man, that you care for him?
You made him a little lower than the angels for a while. You crowned him with glory and honour.
You put everything under his feet." When God put everything under him, he left nothing that is not under him. But right now we do not yet see everything under him.
But we do see Jesus. For a little while he was made lower than the angels, and now he is crowned with glory and honour because he suffered death. By God's kindness, he died for everyone.
God made all things, and all things exist for him. He wanted to bring many children to share his glory. So it was right for him to make Jesus, who leads them to salvation, perfect through suffering.
Jesus makes people holy, and those he makes holy belong to the same family. So he is not ashamed to call them his brothers and sisters.
He says, "I will tell my brothers and sisters about your name. I will sing your praise among your people."
He also says, "I will trust in him." And again, "Here I am, with the children God has given me."
Since the children are people of flesh and blood, Jesus also became flesh and blood like them. He did this so that by his death he could destroy the devil, who has the power of death,
and set free all those who were slaves all their lives because they were afraid of dying.
It is clear that he does not come to help angels. He comes to help the children of Abraham.
So he had to become like his brothers and sisters in every way. Then he could be a high priest who is kind and faithful in serving God, and he could take away the sins of the people.
Because he himself suffered when he was tempted, he is able to help those who are being tempted.
